scope: Source-photo discovery and reuse; NOT blanket artwork exclusion or release certification

mandatoryChecks: image-specific licence permitting publication and required alterations
original file URL and licensing evidence captured
native resolution, framing, fidelity, colour and composition before pristine certification
policy.referenceOnlyMeaning: Institution-supplied photos not eligible for automated ingestion, publication, crop or modification; image metadata and object research remain usable within applicable data terms; independently sourced PD/CC0 photos of same painting can still be reviewed individually.
allowedImageLicences: Public Domain Mark or institution-confirmed no known copyright restrictions with unrestricted reuse
policy.noCost: No purchases, paid licences, fee-based API plans or paid storage
policy.precedence: Check exact work across all PRIMARY_OPEN institutions and open independent reproductions before restricted museum photography; ensure no change to historical user selections
policy.productionFlag: never auto-publish: source rights and native photo QA must pass independently
